how: Rendered in SSORT REV 161 for every rig in its rig list and every surface test type; every EDS sequence (eds_seq), ROV sheet (rov_sheet) and EHBS shear choice (ehbs_shear) selected in turn and the union of keys kept. "variant" is the selector value under which the key first appeared ("" = always present). Labels: labelledInTool=true is the tool's own data-soak-label; false is read from the page: for a header field, the text immediately before the input ("Date", "Well"); for a table cell, the row's own text (step number, function, description) then the column heading ("Verified", "Actual Time"), merged headings resolved. One correction applied after harvest: on BOP Function Test rows with no volume reading, the per-pod ft_r<i>_<b|y>_pf cell sits under the Vol column; its label is set to "Pass / Fail" (540 keys).
payload: tiles[].sbopData = { testType, date, soak: { key: value } } - only non-empty values are posted, and SSORT posts NO labels for these keys.
